children: JSW Steel Limited (NSE:JSWSTEEL) reported robust Q2 FY27 results with Rs 5,279cr profit, 21% revenue growth and rising exports, while greenlighting major capex—Utkal Phase II and JVML upgrades—plus coal assets to secure feedstock as it races to add 25 Mtpa by FY31 and align with India’s steel goals.
JSW Steel Strong Q2 FY27 Profit Growth
: JSW Steel (JSWSTEEL) Q2 FY27: net profit Rs 5,279cr, revenue Rs 54,486cr (+21% YoY), volumes 7.46 Mt (+15% YoY), EBITDA margin 18.6%, exports 0.98 Mt (+35%).
Utkal Phase II Capex Expansion Planned
: JSW Steel approved Utkal Phase II: 5 Mtpa expansion with capex ~INR 162 billion. Also approved INR 70 billion for JVML efficiency. Total planned capex INR 1.48 trillion to add 25 Mtpa by FY31
: JSW Steel (JSWSTEEL) is securing coking coal supply via a 30% stake in an Australian mine and a Mozambique project targeting about 11 million tonnes of hard coking coal production.
Policy Names JSW Steel Big Player
: India’s draft National Steel Policy 2047 names JSW Steel (JSWSTEEL) among large producers expected to modernize plants and add capacity to meet 604 Mtpa target and reduce CO2 intensity to 1.54 t/t.
